question_text: Distinguish RAM from SSD storage when a workstation runs a program.
adaptation_rationale: Original application rewritten to be self-contained; assessed reasoning retained within cited 2027 scope.
solution: RAM holds active instructions/data for fast CPU access; SSD stores programs/files long-term.; RAM normally loses its data without power whereas SSD retains it.; RAM is generally faster but lower-capacity/more costly per unit than SSD.
